data.description:
Found 2026-09-13 while smoke-testing the v0.66.1 staging build (Release) for C11-225. After `select-workspace` moved to another workspace, the previously selected workspace's selected-in-pane terminal (surface:2) never transitioned: `get-metadata` shows no `lifecycle_state` at all (SurfaceLifecycleController only writes the key on a transition), and a 5 s `sample` shows its Ghostty renderer thread as busy occluded (23 render-work samples) as visible (18). The same procedure on a tagged Debug build did throttle (lifecycle_state=throttled, renderer 20 -> 0), so the C11-225 engine change works when c11 actually tells Ghostty the surface is hidden.

Production (0.65.0 Release, 9 workspaces) confirms it is a reliability bug, not a Debug/Release difference in the engine: of the hidden workspaces' selected terminals, 7 read `lifecycle_state = active` and 2 `throttled`; every non-selected tab in those workspaces reads `throttled` (24 total). So tab-switch throttling works; workspace-deselect throttling fires only sometimes. Those 7 always-active surfaces are exactly where agents stream (orchestrators, delegators), and they were most of the 18 busy renderer threads in the original load sample.

Mechanism (probable): the transition is driven from the view. `TerminalPanelView` calls `panel.applyVisibility(isVisibleInUI)` from `.onAppear` / `.onChange(of: isVisibleInUI)`; `isVisibleInUI` comes from `MountedWorkspacePresentationPolicy.isPanelVisible` in ContentView.swift, and the deselected workspace's subtree is wrapped in `AppKitHiddenWrapper` (NSHostingController with `view.isHidden = true`). A hidden hosting controller's SwiftUI subtree may not get its body update (and therefore its onChange) until it is shown again, at which point the value is already true again, so the false edge is lost. Whether the edge lands depends on ordering between the isHidden flip and the SwiftUI update, which explains the 7/2 split.

Fix: drive lifecycle from the model, not the view. In `TabManager.selectedTabId.didSet` (Sources/TabManager.swift ~945), after the switch, call a new `Workspace.applyPanelVisibility(workspaceVisible:)` on the previous and new workspaces; it iterates `panels`, computes `isSelectedInPane` via `bonsplitController.selectedTab(inPane:)`, and calls `panel.applyVisibility(workspaceVisible && isSelectedInPane)` for terminal and browser panels (operator-pinned `hibernated` is preserved by applyVisibility already). Keep the view-driven path as is; transitions are idempotent. Also apply on pane-tab selection change if that path has the same gap (verify with get-metadata after `focus-surface` inside a hidden workspace).

Validation (both Debug tagged and Release staging, nap-free: NSAppSleepDisabled on the test bundle id, window parked on screen): after `select-workspace` away, every terminal in the old workspace reads `throttled` within 1 s and the previously selected one's renderer thread shows 0 render-work samples in a 5 s `sample` while a loop streams into it; `select-workspace` back reads `active` and on-screen content is current. Add a runtime test through the socket for the metadata assertion. Ship in v0.66.1 with C11-224/C11-225 (release held on this) or as 0.66.2 immediately after.
data.title: Workspace deselection does not reliably throttle its selected surface: hidden-workspace agents keep rendering

provenance.reason: Brief in plans/C11-228-delegator-brief.md; delegator launching in workspace c11

data.body:
Inline self-review of 1eb8c95b6 (origin/main...fix/C11-228-throttle-on-deselect), PR #447. Verdict: approve, no blocking findings.

Against the plan:
- `Workspace.applyPanelVisibility(workspaceVisible:)` walks panes then tabs (O(tabs)) and reuses `WorkspaceContentView.panelVisibleInUI`, so the model and the view compute the same answer. With `workspaceVisible=false` the rule returns false before `isFocused` is read, so a hidden workspace can never activate a panel.
- `TabManager.selectedTabId.didSet`: the call is synchronous and sits after `guard selectedTabId != oldValue`, outside the async generation block, so a newer switch cannot supersede it. Workspaces are resolved by id from `tabs`; a closed previous workspace is skipped.
- `Workspace.applyTabSelection`: runs after the coalescing loop, once selection has settled, and still runs when the loop breaks at 8 iterations. It is gated on `owningTabManager`, so a detached workspace mid-move does nothing. This is an edge path only; no typing-latency path is touched.
- Hibernated stays pinned (`applyVisibility` returns early). Firing from both the model and the view does no harm.

Considered and accepted:
- A retiring workspace, still drawn during the switch handoff, is throttled right away at `didSet` and holds its last frame instead of streaming. Visual cost is negligible; noted in the PR.
- Session restore: restored workspaces get throttled via `applyTabSelection` while `selectedTabId` is still nil, then the `didSet` or the view's `onAppear` activates the selected one. That is correct.
- Model and view can disagree only while a workspace is retiring (model says false, view says true), and the view settles to false afterwards. No steady state exists where a visible surface stays throttled.

Tests: three `WorkspaceSelectionLifecycleTests` in `c11Tests`, confirmed to be that target in the pbxproj. They cover deselect/select in both directions (controller state plus `lifecycle_state` metadata), a tab created inside a hidden workspace, and hibernated staying pinned. All are behavioral; no source-text assertions. Nothing was built locally (brief); CI is the gate.

Validation handoff: per the delegator brief, no local build (Low Power Mode). Gate is CI on PR #447 (checks running: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/447/checks), including the 3 new c11Tests WorkspaceSelectionLifecycleTests. The orchestrator reviewed and approved #447, merges on green, and owns running-system validation on a nap-free staging build (C11-225 procedure: get-metadata lifecycle_state=throttled for every terminal in the old workspace after select-workspace; renderer idle in sample).

Orchestrator review of PR #447: synchronous applyPanelVisibility from TabManager.selectedTabId.didSet (cannot be superseded by the async block), shares WorkspaceContentView.panelVisibleInUI so model and view agree, idempotent, hibernation preserved, tab-select-inside-hidden-workspace covered via the Bonsplit delegate; three behavioral c11Tests. CI green (build incl. host tests, compat, Drawbridge). Squash-merged as 7623fe5c3.

provenance.reason: PR #447 squash-merged as 7623fe5c3; staging re-smoke follows on the release branch

data.body: Release staging rel-v0.66.1 (f9991a86a, NSAppSleepDisabled on the staging bundle id, window on screen): after select-workspace away, all 4 terminals in the hidden workspace read lifecycle_state=throttled within 2 s; the streaming terminal's Ghostty renderer thread went 17 render-work samples (visible) to 0 (hidden) in 5 s samples; select back reads active and on-screen timestamp within 130 ms of wall clock; no hang-monitor entries. Before this fix on the same binary the surface never transitioned and its renderer stayed at 23.
